title: Chicken Katsu Curry

extendedIngredients.name: Japanese curry roux
extendedIngredients.original: 1 x 92 g packet Japanese curry roux

steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook it by absorption or in a rice cooker. Keep warm.
Halve each chicken breast horizontally, then pound the pieces between sheets of baking paper to about 1 cm thick. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

Set up three shallow bowls: the plain flour in one, the eggs beaten in the second, the panko breadcrumbs in the third. Coat each piece of chicken in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into the panko so the crumbs stick. Set aside.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Dice the brown onion and crush the garlic, then cook them for 5 minutes until soft. Peel and chop the carrots and potatoes into bite-sized chunks, add them to the pan and stir for 2 minutes.

Pour in the chicken stock and bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Take the pan off the heat, break in the Japanese curry roux and stir until dissolved, then simmer for 3 minutes more until thick and glossy.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat until a pinch of panko sizzles straight away. Fry the chicken in two batches for 3-4 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack and rest for a few minutes.
Slice the katsu into strips. Divide the rice between bowls, ladle the curry over one side and top with the sliced chicken.
